title: AITBASE VISION plugin manifest (plugin.json), draft
description: aitbase-plugin check enforces these rules and more (source id match, file names, screens). Keep both in sync.

id.description: Stable plugin id: two or more dot-separated lowercase parts. aitbase.* is reserved for official plugins. Must match AITBASE_PLUGIN_ID(...) in the source.

name.description: Display name. The device's assistant opens the plugin by this name, so keep it short and easy to say.

api_version.description: Plugin API version the plugin is written against.

entry.description: Build target name of the plugin program.

screens.description: Screens in ui/screens/<name>.xml, opened with aitbase_ui_open(p, "<name>", ...).

idle_face.description: One of ui.screens, offered as the device's home screen face (since SDK 0.10). The owner chooses it on the Device Console; the device shows it display only (no buttons or actions, at most 24 widgets and 8 KiB compiled) under its own badge. Its labels bind to face.1 to face.16, set with aitbase_face_set.

sounds.description: Sounds in sounds/<name>.wav (16 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM, at most 10 s), played with aitbase_audio_play(p, "<name>", ...), only while the plugin's screen is visible.

triggers.description: Starts the plugin without the user opening it. One kind: a schedule, every every_min minutes (15 to 1440) while the device is idle. aitbase_trigger() returns "schedule" for such a run.

assistant_tools.description: Tools the device's voice assistant may call (since SDK 0.10, D31): the plugin gets AITBASE_EVENT_TOOL_CALL and answers with aitbase_tool_reply within 5 s. The device starts a plugin that isn't running, without a screen. Every declared argument is required. An invalid block offers no tools; the plugin still runs.

description.description: One line the assistant reads to choose the tool.

settings.description: Values the owner fills in on the Device Console (since SDK 0.12, device decision D38), such as a server address and a token. They are saved in the plugin's storage on the SD card: read them with aitbase_storage_get(p, "settings.<key>"). A secret is never shown again on the console. A running plugin gets AITBASE_EVENT_DEVICE with op "plugin.settings_changed" when the owner saves. An invalid block offers no settings; the plugin still runs.

requested_capabilities.description: Ignored since SDK 0.11 (device decision D32): every plugin may use every capability. Devices before 2026-10-20 still need it. check warns CAPABILITIES_IGNORED.
